cards.text: Friend, the word of the LORD comes to a man named Hosea son of Beeri, at a time when God's people have two kingdoms, Judah and Israel. It comes in the days of FOUR of Judah's kings: Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz and Hezekiah. Over in Israel, the king is Jeroboam son of Jehoash.
Then the LORD first speaks through Hosea. He tells Hosea to go, take a prostitute as his wife and have children of adultery.

cards.question: The LORD tells Hosea to take a prostitute as his wife and have children of adultery. What reason does He give?

answers.text: The land is departing from the LORD
Hosea has been hiding from the LORD
The kings have stopped praying to the LORD

cards.question: After the LORD tells Hosea to take a prostitute as his wife, Hosea pushes back and refuses to go.

cards.text: Hosea goes and marries Gomer daughter of Diblaim. Friend, some folks need a WHOLE meeting just to switch desks at work, and Hosea gets asked THIS and just goes.
Gomer gives Hosea a son, and the LORD tells Hosea to name him Jezreel. Soon, the LORD says, He'll bring the bloodshed of Jezreel upon the house of Jehu, a former king of Israel (2 Kings 9:6).

cards.question: Along with bringing bloodshed on the house of Jehu, the LORD says He'll put an end to the kingdom of ___.
The LORD speaks of a day in the Valley of Jezreel. What does He say He'll break there?

cards.text: Gomer has a daughter next, and the LORD says to name her Lo-ruhamah. The reason, He says, is that He'll no longer have compassion on the house of Israel, that He should ever forgive them.

cards.question: After saying He'll no longer have compassion on Israel, the LORD says He'll have no compassion on the house of Judah either.
The LORD says He'll save the house of Judah. How will they be saved?

answers.text: By bow and sword in battle

cards.text: After Gomer weans Lo-ruhamah, she has another son. I bet Hosea holds his breath for this one's name, friend, the way I held mine every time the junk drawer I was stuck in slid open.

cards.question: When the LORD says to name Hosea's second son Lo-ammi, the reason He gives is "you are not My people, and I am not your God."

cards.text: I think that last name hurts, friend. But hang in there, because Hosea's story isn't over.
